initial_level: target alpha from the source-run configuration
update_unit: One arrived known audit label; all arrivals are processed before the next daily predictions.
historical_errors: Use the actual rejection decision at the original prediction time.
reference_distribution: Known audit scores within the same past-only 28-calendar-day window; initial calibration if empty.
unknown_labels: Count toward requests; excluded from known-score reference and known-risk error updates.
level_bounds: Unclipped ACI level; levels <=0 give +inf and levels >=1 give -inf thresholds.
provenance: Gibbs and Candes, JMLR 25(162), 2024, Section 2.2, equation (4).
claim_boundary: Budgeted delayed-label adaptation. Original full-feedback theoretical guarantees are not claimed.
